source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Click tab "Dashboard"
And also enter "Server Health" -> "Sensor Reading"

    【After Test】

    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor Reading & Threshold is human reable and match with spec.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" sensor get 'PWR_GB_HSC1~PWR_GB_HSC10' 2>&1; echo ---SDR-FALLBACK---; ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" sdr elist 2>&1 | head -100
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: returns FULL raw `ipmitool (OOB lanplus) sensor get "<SENSOR>"` reading + threshold; user judges (read-only).

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES treats `HSC1~HSC10` as a single sensor string. It neither expands ten channels nor establishes what HSC denotes, which downstream domains the channels protect, whether the value is input current-derived power or another quantity, and which limits apply.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED correctly makes HSC semantics, mapping and ten separate reads prerequisites. V3.1 further requires a power-tree association from every controller to its upstream feed and downstream GPU-baseboard load, controller identity/register/scaling, and distinction between passive display acceptance and the separate dynamic protection case.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 899/2291 accepts command presence and a literal range without ten-channel expansion, HSC/power-tree identity, controller telemetry provenance, UI completeness or specification traceability.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: Wistron-BMC-00084-V003 uses the same labels in a load/protection context and suggests the HSCs serve stressed module power domains, but it does not define the topology and does not authorize stimulus here. Wistron-BMC-00191-V003 is a separate standby-HSC power point, not an eleventh interchangeable member.
historical_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: No Wistron-BMC-00190-V003 or case_variant_id 090021d31f0d8d4f record exists in the invalidated run; only the related dynamic Wistron-BMC-00084-V003 draft was found.
historical_reviews.v3: The prior pilot/V3 treatment of Wistron-BMC-00084-V003 gates dynamic load and protection coverage behind an approved HSC topology and envelope. That decision supplies context but cannot stand in for this row's ten passive display checkpoints.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-33 preserves the Master names; ED-34 treats the HSC expansion, power tree, limits and inaccessible Script as Project readiness; ED-35 prohibits importing module stress or controller trip testing into this passive row; ED-38 requires complete protected evidence without log clearing, mutation or retry and leaves verdict ownership with engineering.

original_test_intent: Verify `PWR_GB_HSC1` through `PWR_GB_HSC10` are ten distinct power telemetry records for the Project-defined GPU-baseboard HSC domains, and that Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading show the correct controller/domain identity, measured quantity, units, health state and supported thresholds for the present passive condition.
original_method: First obtain the authoritative HSC and power-tree map, then enumerate each exact SDR/UI record and correlate it to one controller, upstream feed and downstream protected domain. Compare nontruncated read-only values and thresholds with controller-specific specifications while recording the existing load state; do not add load or trip stimulation from the Assert-DeAssert row.
manual_activity: A platform power owner must identify HSC1-10 on the schematic/power tree, associate each with its feed and protected load, and approve channel-specific acceptance. An agent may then collect passive telemetry and UI state. A person confirms fitted population and the operating condition and decides the result; this row contains no permission to load or trip a controller.
required_inputs: Chassis and GPU-baseboard PN/revision plus authoritative HSC abbreviation/function
HSC1-10 controller PN/revision/serial or designator, physical location, upstream feed and downstream module/connector/rail mapping
Per-channel management controller/bus/mux/address/register, measured quantity, units, scaling, calibration tolerance and averaging interval
Stable SDR and WebUI identities with normal range, warning/critical values, hysteresis and state semantics
Rules for unfitted, disabled, standby, host-off, zero, unavailable, stale and controller-fault states
Recorded PSU feeds/redundancy, HSC enable/fault state, GPU/module population and current host/load/cooling condition
Protected supported OOB/API/browser tool and pinned reviewed `sensor.git` revision or an approved manual alternative
safety_requirements: Preserve SEL, controller-fault, kernel and power logs; do not perform the generic source clear step for this passive evidence check.
Never send `PWR_GB_HSC1~PWR_GB_HSC10` as one IPMI sensor name. Enumerate ten exact records and retain each stable SDR identity.
Do not assume HSC means hot-swap controller solely from the abbreviation; confirm its Project definition and controller topology before interpreting values.
Do not infer controller-to-GPU/module mapping from numbering adjacency. Use the approved power tree and fitted hardware identity.

Do not start a GPU/module workload, vary connector load, trip an HSC, disconnect a feed, reset/power-cycle hardware, change thresholds or update firmware. Those actions belong to separately approved functional coverage.
Do not compare controller input power with downstream GPU device power unless conversion losses, auxiliaries, boundary and sample window are accounted for.
Use secret-safe transport rather than command-line `-P`; do not assume cipher 17, truncate the SDR inventory, execute the inaccessible Script or retry after a missing/faulted controller.
agent_execution_scope: Verify the Project HSC definition, ten-controller power-tree/SDR/UI map, fitted population, supported protected client and reference revision; prepare ten expected rows.

Read HSC1-10 separately and capture controller identity, upstream/downstream domain, value, units, status, threshold capability/values, integration window and timestamp from the supported OOB path and both UI locations.
Record contemporaneous PSU/feed, host power, GPU/module presence/load and cooling state, then apply only the approved passive channel-specific acceptance rules.
Return full raw and redacted UI evidence without clear, load, trip, feed, reset, power, threshold, firmware or automatic-retry actions and without assigning DUT PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED.
engineer_actions: Approve the HSC meaning and one-to-one HSC1-10 controller/feed/protected-domain map, explicitly separating PWR_STBY_HSC.
Supply controller interface/scaling/window and per-domain acceptable values, thresholds/status/freshness and nonapplicable-state handling; approve the evidence tool or Project Override.
Evaluate all applicable controllers individually and issue the formal verdict; report unfitted channels as Project-defined N/A rather than silently reducing the ten-point source scope.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The literal tilde expression is not a standard range expansion and cannot return ten independently attributable channels. The command also lacks the HSC power-tree/controller map, truncates discovery, exposes the password and assumes cipher-suite support.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Enumerate the complete SDR/API inventory, resolve ten exact HSC records through the approved controller map, query each over protected read-only access and correlate every result with its unchanged Dashboard and Server Health row.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All ten labels, two WebUI locations, source Criteria, Script, clear-log wording, DeepSeek proposal and 1/0-minute estimates remain recorded. The Review does not edit Master, guess raw registers or import dynamic load coverage.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a ten-row controller matrix keyed by schematic designator, upstream feed and downstream protected domain; collect time-aligned SDR/API and UI fields plus current feed/load state and compare each to its own calibrated passive limits.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The precise GPU-baseboard/HSC population and BMC monitoring implementation specified by the Project.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record chassis/baseboard revision, HSC controller revisions, BMC/SDR/WebUI firmware, monitor firmware, management client and Script commit.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project power tree/schematic, HSC controller data sheet and telemetry register definition, BMC SDR repository and WebUI schema.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Expands the shorthand into ten traceable power domains and adds controller provenance, power-tree causality and full UI/raw evidence without changing the passive intent.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Passive display does not verify inrush limiting, overload/trip/retry, hot-swap behavior, dynamic response, shutdown/fan policy or recovery; PWR_STBY_HSC remains separate.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: HSC definition, ten-domain power tree, controller telemetry/scaling, state-specific acceptance and a validated evidence path.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Identical controller types can monitor different rails; numbering may not follow physical slots, and input versus downstream power differs due to conversion and auxiliary consumption.

project_override_considerations: A Project-approved Redfish/OEM or controller-vendor interface may replace or corroborate ipmitool only if the original method remains recorded, the reason and engineer approval are documented, and equivalence covers every applicable HSC1-10 controller identity, boundary, value, units, thresholds, status and freshness. A subset or the standby HSC cannot be claimed as all ten.
expected_evidence: Chassis/GPU-baseboard/BMC identity and approved HSC definition
Ten-row controller designator/location/upstream-feed/downstream-domain/fitted-population and SDR/UI identity matrix
Per-controller interface/register/scaling/calibration/window plus complete raw value, units, threshold capability/values, state and synchronized timestamp
Redacted Dashboard and Server Health rows with current PSU/feed, host, module/GPU load and cooling context

Specification comparison and explicit disposition for unfitted/standby/off/zero/unavailable/stale/faulted points, protected tool/Script provenance, no-mutation/no-retry proof and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Although HSC and its topology are not defined, the Items, Sensor Page navigation and readability/specification Criteria consistently describe passive presentation of ten power channels. The missing power-tree semantics are provisionable Project inputs, not contradictory test purposes.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The passive ten-channel display objective is clear enough to review safely. Once the expected Project schematic, controller map and specifications are supplied, read-only evidence can proceed, so permanent BLOCKED would incorrectly turn readiness gaps into an irreducible conflict.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Changes unsupported YES to PACKAGE, expands ten actual targets and rejects the literal range/truncated fallback.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains PACKAGE and adds controller designator, upstream/downstream power-tree causality, state-specific calibration and explicit separation from standby and dynamic trip coverage.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Replaces superficial command availability with ten-controller traceability and complete UI/raw/spec evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Keeps the dynamic HSC load/protection row and PWR_STBY_HSC separate; neither substitutes for this passive ten-point matrix.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Related invalid dynamic analysis was used only as history; no invalid draft of this exact case exists.

review_improvement: Prevents a failed range lookup or an unmapped current/power value from being reported as complete HSC coverage, and prevents a passive dashboard inspection from silently becoming an overload or hot-swap test.
independent_technical_reasoning: An HSC reading is meaningful only when tied to the exact controller and the portion of the power tree it measures. Ten similarly named channels can have different feeds, conversion boundaries, fitted loads and calibration. The separate dynamic case indicates these channels may protect stressed modules, but that relationship must be proven from Project design evidence and must not broaden this row into service-impacting stimulus.
